title.narrative: Empowering Rural Women and GBV survivors in two woredas of Tigray Through Leadership, Advocacy and Economic Initiatives

description.narrative: The project is part of the EU CSF Plus Programme titled “Strengthening the Capacities of Grassroots CSOs in Ethiopia.” It aims to enhance the rights, safety, justice, and economic autonomy of women and girls, especially GBV survivors and returnees, through a survivor-centred protection system and strengthened female leadership in Raya Alamata and Tahtay Adiyabo Wereda. To improve access to safe, confidential, and integrated GBV response services by establishing/ strengthening two GBV response centers in health facilities (one per woreda) by December 2026, benefiting at least 100 survivors, 50% adult women, 40% adolescent girls and young women, and 10% persons with disabilities (PWDs) To empower 200 women and girls by mid-2026 to lead community safety initiatives and advocate for improved local GBV accountability, ensuring a representation of 50% women, 40% youth, and 10% PWD in all leadership circles To enhance the economic autonomy and sustainable livelihoods of 60 GBV survivors by mid-2026 through strengthened vocational and financial management capacities and the establishment of six functional women-led group enterprises (three per woreda), including 50% adult women, 40% young women, and 10% persons with disabilities (PWDs).
